newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 4.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

MCI Communications Corp said on Sunday it would redefine its relations with News Corp and would cut its stake in satellite broadcasting venture, ASkyB, to about 20 percent from 50 percent. MCI had a option to build up a stake of up to 13 percent in News Corp itself.
BHP won final approval from Canadian government on Friday for its C$860 million Artic diamond mine venture with Canada's Dia Met Minerals Ltd.
Appliance and building materials manufacturer reported 10.4 percent lower half year net profit of A$23.85 million to September 30.

Sydney Morning Herald reports Optus Communications not likely to raise capital from the public due to not obstacles posed by legal actions against Optus Vision and prospectus regulations. 25 percent shareholder Mayne seen as entree to Optus Communications share ownership if it raises capital from existing shareholders.
Shares in the Papua New Guinean government's resources group made strong debut on Friday.
